issue.body:
Is your feature request related to a problem
Yes.
Currently, fastapi support raise HttpExpection in dependency and return a response struct like this:
{detail: "error"}.

I want to be able to return a self-defined response, but I can't because now I can only return {"detail": xxxxx}

The solution you would like
For example, I want to
return HttpException(status_code=200, data={"haha":"Hello", "code": 20000}),
and the frontend recieve successful reponse struct like this:
{
data:{"haha":"Hello", "code": 20000},
code: 200
}

Thank you!
issue.title: return response directly in dependency
